description: Official ZCode plugins marketplace: built-in and community plugins for ZCode.

plugins.name: example-plugin
plugins.description: A minimal ZCode template plugin demonstrating the recommended structure: manifest, command, skill, hooks, and MCP sample config. Copy it to start a new plugin.

description_i18n.en: A minimal ZCode template plugin demonstrating the recommended structure: manifest, command, skill, hooks, and MCP sample config. Copy it to start a new plugin.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一个最小 ZCode 模板插件，演示推荐目录结构（manifest、command、skill、hooks、MCP 样例配置）。新建插件时可直接复制。

plugins.name: cloudbase-skills
plugins.description: CloudBase development skills and MCP integration for building, deploying, and troubleshooting Web, WeChat Mini Program, database, cloud function, CloudRun, storage, and AI projects.

description_i18n.en: CloudBase development skills and MCP integration for building, deploying, and troubleshooting Web, WeChat Mini Program, database, cloud function, CloudRun, storage, and AI projects.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 腾讯云 CloudBase 开发技能与 MCP 集成，覆盖 Web、微信小程序、数据库、云函数、云托管、云存储和 AI 项目的开发、部署与排障。

plugins.name: mimosa
plugins.description: Local-first security guardrails for ZCode with pre-write hooks, end-of-turn review, Git gates, commands, a security-scan skill, and an optional MCP server for sealed deep scans.

description_i18n.en: Local-first security guardrails for ZCode with pre-write hooks, end-of-turn review, Git gates, commands, a security-scan skill, and an optional MCP server for sealed deep scans.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode 的本地优先代码安全防线，提供写入前 Hook、任务收尾复查、Git 门禁、命令、安全扫描 Skill，以及用于密封深扫的可选 MCP 服务。

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub CLI workflows for commits, pull requests, issues, releases, Actions, repositories, Codespaces, and other GitHub resources.

description_i18n.en: GitHub CLI workflows for commits, pull requests, issues, releases, Actions, repositories, Codespaces, and other GitHub resources.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 基于 GitHub CLI 的 GitHub 工作流，覆盖提交、Pull Request、Issue、Release、Actions、仓库、Codespaces 等资源。

plugins.name: video-agent-kit
plugins.description: 自动化视频剪辑工具包: 标准云端语音转录与合成、完整视频抽帧理解、局部复看、时间线、预览渲染、QC 和 TTS。

description_i18n.en: Automated video editing toolkit: standard cloud speech transcription and synthesis, full video frame extraction and understanding, local re-inspection, timeline, preview rendering, QC, and TTS.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 自动化视频剪辑工具包: 标准云端语音转录与合成、完整视频抽帧理解、局部复看、时间线、预览渲染、QC 和 TTS。

plugins.name: video2code
plugins.description: 基于 ZCode 内置 Browser Use WebView 录制 WebM 并用 ffmpeg 转成 MP4/URL 复刻；无需 Playwright 或外部 Chromium

description_i18n.en: Records WebM through ZCode's built-in Browser Use WebView and converts it to MP4 with ffmpeg for video/URL replication; no Playwright or external Chromium required.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 基于 ZCode 内置 Browser Use WebView 录制 WebM 并用 ffmpeg 转成 MP4/URL 复刻；无需 Playwright 或外部 Chromium

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous experiment loop for ZCode: set a goal, pick a mechanical metric, and let the agent iterate — measure, keep what works, revert what doesn't, repeat. Provides init/run/log experiment tools (MCP), a loop protocol skill, guardrails (frozen benchmark, checks backpressure, memory injection, Stop continuation), and a static dashboard export.

description_i18n.en: Autonomous experiment loop for ZCode: set a goal, pick a mechanical metric, and let the agent iterate — measure, keep what works, revert what doesn't, repeat.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 自主实验循环：设定目标与机械度量，让 agent 迭代——测量、保留有效改动、回滚无效改动、循环往复。
